title: Output of Sanctions Screener
description: One row per unique name in the default dataset (bad inputs and outages included as free rows); a run summary with list dates in the OUTPUT record.

results.title: Screening results
results.description: One row per name. Example: {"name":"Rosneft","status":"potential_match","topScore":100,"matches":[{"list":"uk","listedName":"ROSNEFT"}]}. Clear: {"name":"Acme Ltd","status":"clear","matchCount":0}.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: JSON: namesRequested, screened, clear, potentialMatches, byStatus, lists (records and list date per source), listsNotChecked, zeroResultsReason, nextSteps.
